title: Explore IDEA
See what it can do
default_suggestion_prompts.content: Give me a concise tour of IDEA's main capabilities and suggest a good first task to try.

title: Analyze data
Start with an upload
default_suggestion_prompts.content: Show me how to upload a scientific dataset and ask IDEA to inspect, summarize, and visualize it.

title: Plot a climate index
Try a reproducible demo
default_suggestion_prompts.content: Demonstrate IDEA by retrieving and plotting the Oceanic Niño Index, then briefly explain the result.

title: Search literature
Use a Literature collection
default_suggestion_prompts.content: Explain how to add scientific papers as a Literature collection and ask evidence-based questions about them.

title: Build an Assistant
Create your own IDEA
default_suggestion_prompts.content: Walk me through creating a custom Assistant with specialized instructions and suggested prompts.

title: Work reproducibly
Code, files, and outputs
default_suggestion_prompts.content: Explain how IDEA uses its Python kernel, workspace files, and downloadable outputs to keep an analysis reproducible.

assistants.name: Welcome Assistant
assistants.description: Introduces IDEA, explains its capabilities, and helps users get started.

assistants.name: SEA
assistants.description: Analyzes UHSLC sea-level, tide, datum, benchmark, and coastal-flooding data.

title: Plot sea level
Honolulu station 057
suggestion_prompts.content: Plot the last six months of hourly sea level for Honolulu (station 057) relative to Station Zero.

title: Estimate a trend
Use the full daily record
suggestion_prompts.content: Estimate and plot the annualized sea-level trend for Honolulu (station 057) using the full daily Fast Delivery record.

title: Explain datums
MSL, MHHW, and HAT
suggestion_prompts.content: Retrieve the datum table for Honolulu (station 057) and explain the relationships among MSL, MHHW, HAT, and Station Zero.

title: Check recent water levels
Observation versus prediction
suggestion_prompts.content: Compare recent RAPID observations and tide predictions for Honolulu (station 057), and summarize the residuals.

title: Explore benchmarks
Map station monuments
suggestion_prompts.content: Map and summarize the tide-gauge benchmarks associated with Honolulu station 057, including available photographs.

title: Assess flooding
Compare with tidal datums
suggestion_prompts.content: Assess recent coastal flooding potential at Honolulu station 057 by comparing consistent-unit water levels with MHHW and HAT.

assistants.name: Mars Assistant
assistants.description: Explores NASA InSight atmospheric observations, Mars time, imagery, and mission science.

title: Plot pressure
Explore InSight sol 100
suggestion_prompts.content: Load InSight pressure observations for sol 100, validate the data, and plot pressure with both sol and UTC context.

title: Explore temperature
Summarize a Martian day
suggestion_prompts.content: Analyze the TWINS air-temperature observations for sol 200 and summarize the diurnal temperature cycle.

title: Convert Mars time
Relate sols to UTC
suggestion_prompts.content: Convert InSight sol 675 to its approximate UTC date and explain the Martian-sol conversion.

title: Compare pressure
Look across multiple sols
suggestion_prompts.content: Compare validated InSight pressure patterns for sols 100, 200, and 300 using a consistent time resolution.

title: Inspect an image
View the InSight landing site
suggestion_prompts.content: Display and scientifically describe one of the sample InSight surface images from sol 675.

title: Review the mission
Atmospheric science overview
suggestion_prompts.content: Give me a concise overview of the InSight mission's atmospheric instruments, datasets, and promising analysis questions.
